statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a documented history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The patient has a documented history of atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
CPT code 93226 (48-hour Holter monitor) was ordered
The service is intended to correlate symptoms with underlying rhythm disturbances and capture potential arrhythmic events
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
